Package arcade.patch.agent.cell

Class PatchCellContainer

java.lang.Object
arcade.patch.agent.cell.PatchCellContainer
All Implemented Interfaces:
CellContainer
public final class PatchCellContainer extends Object implements CellContainer
Implementation of CellContainer for PatchCell agents.

Cell parameters are drawn from the associated PatchCellFactory instance for the given population.
